name: xblocks.default
title: Plot Contiguous Blocks along x Axis

origin.description: Draw contiguous blocks from an increasing x and a block value y.
origin.usage: xblocks.default(x, y, ..., col = NULL, border = NA, ybottom = par("usr")[3], ytop = ybottom + height, height = diff(par("usr")[3:4]), last.step = median(diff(tail(x))))

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Increasing ordinates. Ties are allowed. A decrease stops with 'x' should be ordered (increasing). A zero-length x draws nothing.

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: A function is applied to x first. Numeric y becomes coverage, !is.na(y). Logical FALSE and missing values become a missing color after rle. Character and factor values are colors; a missing character is not filled.

arguments.name: col
arguments.text: When supplied, it replaces the non-missing block colors, recycled across those blocks only. A logical y with col NULL uses palette()[1].

arguments.name: border
arguments.text: Border color. The default NA draws no border.

arguments.name: ybottom, ytop, height
arguments.text: Vertical position of every block. height is used only as the default of ytop. On a log-y plot both edges are 10^ of the usr values.

arguments.name: last.step
arguments.text: Width of the final block. The default is median(diff(tail(x))). An NA median, including an empty difference, becomes 0.

origin.details: Runs come from rle. Each block starts at the x of its first point and ends at the x of the next run, except the last block, which ends at its own x plus last.step. A missing color is still passed to rect.
origin.value: NULL, invisibly. The check records the rect coordinates.
origin.example: xblocks(c(1, 2, 4, 7, 8), c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, NA), col = c("red", "blue"), ybottom = 0, ytop = 1)

translation.description: Block coordinates from an increasing x and a block value y.
translation.usage: xblocks_default(x, y, col=None, border=None, ybottom=None, ytop=None, height=None, last_step=None, ylog=False, draw=True)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Increasing ordinates. Ties are allowed. A decrease raises ValueError with the R message. An empty x returns None.

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: A callable is applied to x first. Numeric values become coverage. False and missing values become a missing color after the run-length encoding. Strings are colors.

arguments.name: col
arguments.text: Replaces the non-missing block colors and is recycled across those blocks only. A logical y with col omitted uses the first R palette color, black.

arguments.name: border
arguments.text: Border color. None is the R default NA.

arguments.name: ybottom, ytop, height
arguments.text: Vertical edges. height is used only when ytop is omitted. ylog=True applies 10** to both edges, matching par("ylog").

arguments.name: last_step
arguments.text: Width of the final block. None uses the median of the differences of the last six x values, and an empty or missing median becomes 0.

arguments.name: draw
arguments.text: True draws the rectangles. False returns the coordinates and is the timed call.

translation.details: The geometry follows rle, cumsum of the run lengths, and the last-step rule. The comparison passes ybottom and ytop so the open plot window is not part of the numbers. ylog is an argument because the timed call does not read a graphics device.
translation.value: None when x is empty. Otherwise a dict with left, right, bottom, top, col, and border.
translation.example:
from zoo.plot import xblocks_default
print(xblocks_default([1, 2, 4, 7, 8], [True, True, False, True, None], col=["red", "blue"], ybottom=0, ytop=1, draw=False)["left"])
